question: Do interactive Web transformations contain predictive dynamical structure beyond memory and ordinary similarity via an orthogonal falsifiable program — effect factorization with session/state-correlated non-determinism where DOM_before correlates with latent state (or equivalently barrier/committor identifiability or timescale separation) — tested on Intel-supplied production SPAs with title variation and non-leakage transitions (H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 bits, leakage<40%) using leakage-free action definition and history-conditioned PMI/CMI with valid null centering against strong Markov/similarity/trajectory-memory nulls?
hypothesis: On Intel-supplied production SPAs satisfying substrate gates (≥2 unique titles, H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 bits, valid-only leakage<40%, ≥50 non-leakage transitions after leakage-free filtering), DOM_before encodes latent session/state-regime information that factorization predicts: history-conditioned CMI I(S_next ; DOM_before | URL_before, H_K=3, Action) >0 with bias-corrected PMI ≥0.10 bits and Bonferroni-corrected cross-trajectory permutation p<0.005 on ≥2/3 qualifying SPAs for at least one DOM representation. This correlated non-determinism (DOM_before correlates with latent state determining stochastic branch) predicts PMI>0, whereas the falsified independent-noise model (EXP-PHYSICS-34764605162: PMI 0.004–0.025 bits, p=1.0) predicts I=0. Positive control synthetic correlated SPA (DOM_before perfectly proxies latent branch) must show ≥0.5 bits; independent-noise synthetic control must show ~0 bits.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if on all qualifying production SPAs meeting gates, BC PMI ≤0.05 bits or Bonferroni p≥0.005 for every DOM representation, AND history-augmented predictor accuracy delta (DOM+history Markov vs history-only Markov) ≤0.03 with permutation p≥0.05. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if substrate gates fail: <1 SPA qualifies with ≥2 titles AND H>0.2 AND leakage<40% AND ≥50 NL, or positive control fails, or trajectory permutation null is degenerate (|null_std|=0 with singleton strata >50%), or preprocessing leakage (fit on test). SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST only if primary BC PMI ≥0.10 bits & p<0.005 on ≥2/3 SPAs, positive control passes, null controls pass, and delta accuracy >0.03.
baselines: B-HISTORY-MARKOV (strong Markov): P(S_next | URL_before, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) majority-vote predictor trained on train split; primary comparison baseline for beyond-memory dynamics. Expected accuracy = history-conditioned determinism; DOM must exceed this.
B-ACTION-FREQ-SHUFFLE: within-strata shuffle of DOM_before and of S_next; frequency-only predictor P(S_next) and P(Action); tests whether PMI is merely action-frequency effect.

B-DOM-SIMILARITY (kNN/Jaccard): nearest-neighbor predictor using TF-IDF cosine or Jaccard over DOM visible_text_hash / title / a11y text — ordinary similarity null. Must be beaten by history-conditioned CMI, not just raw similarity.
B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY: exact memorization of (URL, H_K, Action)->S_next from train trajectories; tests whether DOM adds beyond trajectory memory.

B-SITE-LEAKAGE-DIAGNOSTIC: action_with_target_href (leaky) vs action_leakageFree (kind+target_sig without href/URL equality). Reports leakage inflation delta = PMI_leaky - PMI_leakageFree; valid inference requires leakageFree PMI alone.

B-INDEPENDENT-NOISE-SYNTHETIC: locally-hosted Express SPA with independent per-step DOM variant draw (parent EXP-PHYSICS-34764605162 replication) expected PMI~0 (0.004-0.025 bits). Contrastive null showing correlated model is distinct.
B-RANDOM-DOM: DOM_before replaced by SHA-256(random_counter) independent of state/action; expected BC PMI ~0 within 3*null_std.
positive_control: Synthetic correlated SPA (3-state branching FSM, latent state L∈{A,B} persisting 3 steps, DOM_before = hash(L) + step label, H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)=1.0 bit by construction, leakage 0%, NL=200). Pipeline must detect BC PMI ≥0.5 bits, Bonferroni p<0.001, Cohen d>2.0, and history+DOM accuracy exceeds history-only by ≥0.10 (permutation p<0.01). Validates estimator can detect correlated non-determinism when it exists; failure → MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
null_control: Two nulls must pass: (1) Shuffled-DOM within (URL,H_K=3) strata on each production SPA: mean BC PMI |mean|<3*std_null and Bonferroni p>0.10 (valid null centering, not Gaussian jitter). (2) Independent-noise synthetic SPA (same FSM but DOM variant drawn i.i.d. per step independent of L) must show BC PMI ≤0.05 bits and p>0.10, replicating parent falsification. Frequency null P(S_next) accuracy = 1/|S_next| also reported. Singleton-strata rate >50% makes permutation degenerate → null invalid → MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not falsification.
measurement_validity: Gate 0 — Substrate qualification (Intel dependency): Intel must supply manifest/provenance for production SPAs (not locally-hosted, not TodoMVC hash-SPAs) with BrowserGym/AgentLab 1280x720 observation capture (DOM, a11y tree, title, URL). SPA qualifies only if after leakage-free filtering: unique_titles≥2 (title entropy>0), H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 bits (computed on pooled NL transitions with ≥5 per stratum), valid-only leakage<40% (link_click where target_href==state_after_url normalized), NL≥50 transitions. If 0 SPAs qualify → MEASUREMENT_INVALID, report substrate_unavailable.
Gated execution: if Gate 0 fails, do not evaluate primary hypothesis; record MEASUREMENT_INVALID with unresolved substrate.

Data: reuse Intel BrowserGym trajectories where available; if new collection required, use Playwright 1280x720, deterministic seeds (Python hash seed, numpy seed 42, sklearn KMeans random_state 42 if clustering used), record raw DOM/a11y/title/URL/action_target/network hashes. Minimum 50 NL per qualifying SPA; target 150 NL to achieve 80% power for 0.10 bits (per parent power).

State S_next = normalized (URL_after + title_after) hash (URL normalized per prior: lowercase, strip session tokens, preserve SPA hash fragment; title lowercased, truncated 200 chars). Alternative S_next variants reported exploratory: URL_only, URL+title, URL+DOM_hash.

Action A = (action_primitive, target_sig_leakageFree) where target_sig = role+name+testid+aria-label without href/URL; primitive in {click, fill, navigate, select, submit}. Link href equality never enters A. Diagnostic A_leaky computed separately for B-SITE-LEAKAGE.

DOM_before representations tested independently: R1 visible_text_hash (SHA-256 of visibleText 0-5k chars), R2 a11y_tree_hash (SHA-256 of serialized AX tree), R3 title_before (raw string, discretized by exact match), R4 combined_hash = SHA-256(R1+R2). Numeric structural features reported exploratory only.

History H_K=3 = last 3 leakage-free actions + last 3 URL_before+title_before states; strata = (URL_before, H_K=3). Rare strata (<5 transitions) excluded from PMI but counted in validity_notes; singleton rate reported.

Estimator: history-conditioned CMI I(S_next; DOM_before | URL,H_K=3, Action) via empirical plug-in with Laplace alpha=1.0 and Miller-Madow bias correction; BC PMI = observed - mean(null) where null = within-strata cross-trajectory permutation (1000 perms, seed 42, group = trajectory_id, shuffle DOM_before labels within strata preserving stratum sizes). Report both Laplace and nosmooth (alpha=0) sensitivity.

Split integrity: preprocessing (any discretization, vocab) fit on TRAIN trajectories only; stratified 70/30 train/test split by trajectory_id (grouped); holdout test used only for accuracy delta B-HISTORY-MARKOV comparison, not for PMI permutation (PMI on pooled but permutation grouped by trajectory). Site identity never enters features.

Sampling integrity: Browser policy documented (Playwright crawler depth 3-5, 50 trajectories/SPA, 10 steps/trajectory, jitter 50-150ms uniform); policy regularity (action distribution) reported and separated from environment dynamics; determinism of seeds documented in provenance.json.

Uncertainty integrity: resampling unit = trajectory_id (grouped permutation, not transition); correlated transitions within trajectory not treated as independent; no Gaussian jitter bootstrap; report 95% CI via grouped permutation percentiles; Bonferroni over #qualifying_SPAs × #representations (max 3×4=12, alpha 0.05/12=0.00417, rounded to 0.005).

Representation integrity: raw observables preserved (DOM bytes, a11y bytes, title string, URL); all derived hashes document loss (hash collision, truncation); result must survive at least one legitimate representation (R1 or R2).

Strong null centering: null distribution is empirical within-strata permutation; null_std must be >0 (≥0.01) for valid centering; degenerate null (|null_std|=0 due to singleton strata) → MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
Auditability: all raw transitions, hashes, strata tables, permutation distributions, and code paths committed with sha256 in provenance.json.
decision_rule: Gate 0 substrate: if <1 SPA qualifies (titles≥2, H>0.2, leakage<40%, NL≥50) → MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate_unavailable, no C-WEB-DYNAMICS update). Else if positive_control BC PMI<0.5 bits or p≥0.001 → MEASUREMENT_INVALID (pipeline blind). Else if null_control degenerate (null_std==0 or shuffled mean |mean|≥3*std) → MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Else primary: count qualifying SPAs where ANY representation achieves BC PMI≥0.10 bits AND Bonferroni p<0.005 AND history+DOM accuracy exceeds B-HISTORY-MARKOV by >0.03 with grouped permutation p<0.05. If count ≥2/3 (≥2 when 3 SPAs, ≥1 when 1-2 SPAs) → SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (correlated non-determinism factorization demonstrates beyond-memory dynamics in this production SPA regime). If count =0 → FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (no DOM-state-correlated predictive structure beyond memory on these SPAs/representations). If 0<count< threshold → MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE (partial). Exploratory: report leakage diagnostic delta, B-DOM-SIMILARITY vs CMI gap, timescale/barrier feasibility for next orthogonal test (committor branching rate, dwell time).
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES validates a mechanical prior beyond memory/similarity: DOM_before factorization captures latent session/state regime on production SPAs (e.g., auth/cart/personalization) with ≥0.10 bits and >3% accuracy gain. SPIDER should distill DOM_before→latent-state detectors as applicability guards for parameterized mechanisms and freshness verification (DOM_before freshness sentinel), and prioritize Intel BrowserGym SPA trajectory collection with title-varying sites for Graph/Product. Next: quantify factorization scope (which DOM signals, which site types) and test delta-repair amortization where latent state drifts.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIED bounds C-WEB-DYNAMICS for this factorization program on tested production SPAs/representations: DOM_before provides no predictive information beyond (URL,H_K=3,Action) even with correlated-state design and H>0.2 non-determinism. SPIDER should NOT invest in DOM_before latent-state detectors as mechanical priors; attribute prior PMI failures to environment class, not estimator. Pivot physics to next orthogonal program per director_mandate: dynamical barrier/committor identifiability from branched evidence (estimate committor from ≥10 revisits to same (URL,DOM) state) or characteristic timescale separation (autocorrelation / dwell times) on same substrate — both test structure without density divergence. Graph/Product continue on trajectory-memory/retrieval without physics prior.
estimated_cost: Low-medium: no LLM calls; BrowserGym/Playwright collection reuse if Intel manifest exists (≈2h if new collection: 3 SPAs ×50 trajectories×10 steps ≈1500 page loads, 1280x720); analysis Python stdlib + sklearn 1.9 + numpy/scipy (≈1h, 1000 perms ×12 configs =12000 PMI fits, <30 min CPU); total <4h wall-clock, <8 GB RAM, no GPU.
expected_information_gain: Very high: first orthogonal falsification beyond 58 synthetic TV/KDE/binned PMI experiments (which showed complementary blind spots kNN rho=-0.12 vs KDE rho=0.286 and 95% pooled attenuation). Directly tests the only surviving plausible mechanism (correlated non-determinism where DOM correlates with latent state) flagged as open after parent's independent-noise falsification (0.004 bits). Substrate-gated design prevents false negative from TodoMVC degeneracy (0 titles, H=0) and resolves synthetic-to-real gap on Intel production SPAs with valid null centering and strong Markov/similarity/memory baselines. Either SURVIVES (first real-SPA beyond-memory dynamics, product-usable detector) or FALSIFIED (closes factorization path, forces barrier/timescale pivot) changes claim and product decision. Tunnel-breaking value exceeds another TV/KDE tuning (near-zero marginal per portfolio_assessment).
